name: fretfree
description: A static sheet-music library and practice workspace for students. No build step; these scripts only run the tests and maintenance tasks.

scripts.test: node tests/check.cjs && node tests/library-ui.cjs && node tests/editor-playback.cjs
scripts.format: prettier --write index.html style.css theme.js shared.js library.js backup.js editor.js measure-tools.js palette.js shortcuts.js playback.js mixer.js keyboard.js assignments.js turn-in.js record.js assess.js app.js score-tools.js rights-tools.js musicxml.js sw.js manifest.webmanifest 'scripts/*.cjs' 'tests/*.cjs'
scripts.format:check: prettier --check index.html style.css theme.js shared.js library.js backup.js editor.js measure-tools.js palette.js shortcuts.js playback.js mixer.js keyboard.js assignments.js turn-in.js record.js assess.js app.js score-tools.js rights-tools.js musicxml.js sw.js manifest.webmanifest 'scripts/*.cjs' 'tests/*.cjs'
